# opusdns_contact (Data Source)

Fetches a single contact from `GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single contact by id.
data "opusdns_contact" "registrant" {
  contact_id = "contact_01jxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

output "registrant_email" {
  value = data.opusdns_contact.registrant.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact_id` (String) Contact id to look up (e.g. `contact_...`).

### Read-Only

- `city` (String)
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_on` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the contact was created.
- `disclose` (Boolean) Whether the contact is publicly disclosed (WHOIS).
- `email` (String)
- `fax` (String)
- `first_name` (String)
- `id` (String) Mirror of `contact_id`.
- `last_name` (String)
- `org` (String) Contact's organization name (optional).
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns this contact.
- `phone` (String)
- `postal_code` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `street` (String)
- `title` (String)
- `updated_on` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the contact was last updated.
